subject.title: [Bug]: Block streaming can drop paragraph separators across streamed updates

question: Should the canonical fix require full paragraph-boundary semantics across in-budget and maxChars split cases, or accept a common-case text-only repair and track overflow boundaries separately?
rationale: Both open candidate PRs target the right shared boundary, but prior review discussion identifies an overflow/maxChars design limit that likely needs maintainer direction before one implementation is selected.

options.title: Require full boundary semantics
options.body: Consolidate on a fix that carries explicit boundary/seam semantics or reserves separator width so all split cases reconstruct correctly without exceeding limits.

options.title: Accept common-case repair
options.body: Land one candidate for the common paragraph case and leave the rare maxChars overflow range as documented follow-up work on this issue or a narrower issue.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers reject the current text-only direction and ask for a fresh design.

recommendation.title: Require full boundary semantics
recommendation.body: Consolidate on a fix that carries explicit boundary/seam semantics or reserves separator width so all split cases reconstruct correctly without exceeding limits.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant current-file blame and earlier coalescer/chunking history both point to this owner as the best routing candidate for the boundary-semantics choice.
